do I fight him at crab if he bought
say: He has an item on you, so trade crabs and do not duel him, or recall yourself and come back even.
more: A fast clear into a recall puts a component on him at the first river meeting. That is enough to swing an even duel.
You do not have to accept the fight. Leaving that side and taking the other crab or your camps costs very little.
check: Whether a crab is still alive on the side away from him.
breaks: If your laners have push on that side and his do not, the numbers matter more than his item; contest it.
basis: pro:A fast clear and recall brings an item to the river

asks: should I help my jungler at crab
do I go to scuttle with my jungler
jungler wants help at crab
leave lane for crab?
say: Push your wave first and then walk to the crab with your jungler, or stay in lane and tell him to give it if you can't.
more: The first crab fights are decided by which laner arrives. If you can push before 2:55 you are that laner.
Leaving a wave that is pushing into you costs minions and experience, and their laner gets to the river before you anyway.
check: Where your wave is and whether the enemy laner has started walking.
breaks: If the enemy laner is already in the river ahead of you, do not follow him in alone; ping your jungler off.
basis: pro:Take the crab on the side where your lanes can move

asks: their jungler is at my buff alone
enemy jungler invading me solo level one
he's fighting me for my buff
one guy in my jungle at the start
say: Against one invader, call your nearest laner and fight him on the buff, or give it and start the other side if he wins level one.
more: A lone invader is betting your laners will not come. One laner stepping in usually ends it, and he is then late to his own camps.
If you give the buff, start the opposite side at once. You lose one buff, not the whole clear.
check: Whether he is really alone, and which of your laners is close enough to help.
breaks: If a second enemy appears, stop fighting and leave; start the other side.
basis: pro:Time in their jungle is time given away

asks: which three camps do I take
three camp path which ones
what camps for a level three gank
red side or blue side three camp
say: Take one side's three camps so you finish beside the lane, or both buffs and one camp if the gank needs both buffs.
more: Three camps reach level three. One side's three keeps the walk short and leaves you next to that side's lane.
Buff, buff and one camp crosses the whole jungle. You arrive a little later but with both buffs, which suits champions who need the mana.
Either way the other three camps are waiting. Go back for them straight after the gank.
check: Which lane you are aiming at, and whether your champion needs blue buff to keep casting.
breaks: If the lane you aimed at is pushed to the enemy tower when you hit three, drop the plan and finish all six camps.
basis: pro:An early gank is paid for in camps

asks: do I path to my winning lane or losing lane
play for strong side or weak side
which lane do I play around
help the lane that's ahead or behind
say: Clear toward the lane that wins its matchup so your plays have backup, or the weaker lane only if it can hold a wave at tower.
more: A lane with push gets to your fights first, so the river and the camps beside it are the safe ones for you.
Playing to the weaker lane can save it, but a gank there needs the wave at your tower, and the jungle beside it belongs to their laner.
Tell the lane you are leaving. It has to give up trades and stay back while you are across the map.
check: Which of your lanes is likely to push early, from the matchup and how level one went.
breaks: If the strong lane's opponent just sits at his tower, there is nothing to gank; spend the time on the other side or on camps.
basis: pro:The jungle beside a losing lane is theirs

when: you are level 3 and it is before 3:30
asks: should I gank mid at level three
mid gank on first clear?
can I gank mid early
gank mid or a side lane first
say: Gank mid if their mid has no dash and stands past the middle, or pick a side lane since it's longer and harder to escape.
more: Mid is the shortest lane, so the target is never far from his tower. It works on immobile champions or after a Flash is gone.
A mid kill pays twice: your mid gets the push, and that push is what wins the crab on either side a moment later.
Side lanes are longer, so a gank there has more room to finish even without much crowd control.
check: Whether their mid has used Flash, and where the mid wave is.
breaks: If their mid is hugging his tower, walk past and keep to your clear or the side lane.

when: the enemy jungler is an early fighting champion and it is before 1:30
asks: their jungler is going to invade me
how do I start against an invading jungler
he's a strong early jungler, where do I start
how do I not get invaded
say: Start beside your weaker lane and finish beside your strongest, so he meets you where help is, or clear fast and give the far crab.
more: An early fighter usually comes for the end of your clear, when you are lowest. Ending beside a lane with push means help reaches you first.
Ask a laner for a ward at the entrance to your second buff. Seeing him walk in is enough to skip that camp and lose nothing else.
You do not have to match him. Camps on time and one crab keep you level until your items arrive.
check: Which of your lanes will have push at about three minutes, and whether anyone warded your second buff.
breaks: If he shows in a lane early, he is not invading; take every camp and the crab nearest you.
basis: pro:The jungle beside a losing lane is theirs

asks: I'm at crab early, do I wait
crab isn't up yet, what do I do
finished clear before crab spawned
wait for scuttle or go gank
say: Wait in the brush beside the crab if it's seconds away, or gank the lane next to you now and come back for it.
more: Being first to the river lets you choose: start the crab the moment it appears, or sit hidden and catch their jungler walking up.
Standing still for long is wasted time, though. A gank from the river side costs nothing while your camps are down.
check: How long until 2:55, and whether the lane beside you is pushed toward your side.
breaks: If you are early because you skipped camps, go back and take them; do not wait in the river.
basis: pro:Gank when your camps are down

when: you are level 3 and the enemy jungler is level 4, before 4:00
asks: he's level four and I'm three
their jungler is a level up at crab
I'm only level three at scuttle
can I fight him a level down
say: Don't fight him a level down; take the crab on the other side, or go finish your skipped camps and meet him even.
more: He has an extra ability point and more stats, and this early that usually decides a duel between junglers.
You are three because camps are still standing. They are the quickest way back to even, and he cannot be at the crab and in your jungle at once.
check: Which of your camps are still up, and which crab he is walking to.
breaks: If your laners arrive first and his cannot, the level matters less; contest with them.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: you are level 4 and the enemy jungler is level 3, before 4:00
asks: I'm level four and he's three
I out-levelled their jungler early
he's a level down, do I fight him
level up on their jungler at crab
say: Look for him at the crab or his remaining camps while you're a level up, or gank now since he can't match you.
more: A level lead this early is real power, and it is gone as soon as he finishes the camps he skipped. Use it in the next minute.
He is three because he ganked or was slowed down, so some of his camps are probably still up. That is where he has to go next.
A gank is the safer use: if he comes to answer, the fight is in your favour.
check: Where he was last seen and which of his camps he has not taken.
breaks: If his nearest laners have push and yours do not, stay out of his jungle; take the crab and gank.
basis: pro:A jungler who is behind has few places to go

when: an allied laner is dead and it is before 4:30
asks: my laner just died, do I cover the lane
top died should I catch the wave
bot's dead do I go hold the tower
laner dead, take their wave?
say: Catch the wave at the tower if it's about to crash and you're close, or keep clearing if it's a long walk.
more: Minions that die to the tower are gold and experience your team loses. Taking them yourself also keeps the tower healthy.
It costs you a camp's worth of time, and it shows their jungler exactly where you are.
Hand the lane back as soon as your laner returns. Staying for a second wave takes his experience.
check: Where that lane's wave is and how far you are from it.
breaks: If two or more enemies are pushing that wave and their jungler is unseen, do not stand under the tower alone; give the wave.

when: you have more kills than the enemy jungler and are the same level or higher, before 6:00
asks: I'm ahead, how do I snowball
I got two kills early what now
how do I press my lead in the jungle
I'm fed early, invade or gank
say: Recall and spend the gold first, then enter his jungle beside your pushing lane, or gank the same lane again if its target has no Flash.
more: Gold in your pocket wins nothing. An item at the next meeting is what makes the lead count.
Taking his camps keeps him behind longer than another kill would, because he has nowhere safe to farm.
A second gank on a lane with no Flash is the cheap option, as long as the wave is not at their tower.
check: Your unspent gold, which lane has push, and whether the target used Flash.
breaks: If their laners near his jungle have push, do not go in even with a lead; take your own camps and the crab.
basis: pro:Skipping the recall keeps camp pace but not power

asks: should I leash my jungler
do we leash
jungler wants a leash, do I help
leash or go to lane
say: Give a couple of hits and leave before the waves meet, or skip it if your lane needs the first push for level two.
more: A short leash saves your jungler health he will want at the first crab or gank.
Staying too long means the enemy reaches the wave first, takes the push and can hit level two before you.
check: Whether your lane matchup is one where reaching level two first decides the early trades.
breaks: If enemies were seen heading to invade, stand guard at the jungle entrance and do not hit the camp.

when: you and the enemy jungler are the same level and it is between 3:30 and 5:00
asks: we're even, what's my plan
even jungle what do I do now
nothing happened early, where do I go
first clear was even now what
say: Recall, then clear toward the side of the next objective so you end there, or gank the lane with a Flash down first.
more: An even first clear means the second one decides things. Where it ends is where you can fight a minute later.
Ending beside dragon or grubs puts you there first with your camps done, which is most of what an early objective takes.
A lane missing Flash is the best gank on the map for several minutes. Take it before the cooldown returns.
check: Which enemy laners used Flash, and which objective your team is better placed to take.
breaks: If their jungler has shown on one side, start your clear on the other and take what he left open.
basis: pro:End the clear beside the lane that matters

asks: how do I clear on Kindred
Kindred first clear
Kindred mark or farm
what do I do early on Kindred
say: Full clear while kiting with Dance of Arrows, then go for the marked camp, or gank a lane if your mark is on that laner.
more: Completed hunts permanently strengthen her abilities, so the marked monster or champion is always part of her path.
Wolf's Frenzy charges as she moves and attacks, and once full her next attack restores health, which keeps a kited clear healthy.
check: Where the current mark is, since the coach cannot see it.
breaks: If the mark is deep in their jungle and their nearby lanes can move first, leave it; a mark is not worth a death.

asks: how do I clear on Rengar
Rengar first clear
Rengar level three gank?
when do I gank on Rengar
say: Full clear using the brush beside each camp to leap, or gank at level three from a lane brush with an empowered Bola Strike.
more: Rengar leaps with his attack while in brush, so stepping back into it between hits speeds the clear and avoids damage.
Every ability builds Ferocity, and at max the next one is empowered. An empowered Bola Strike roots, which is his only hard lockdown early.
Battle Roar heals some of the damage he just took, so use it right after a camp has hit him.
check: Whether there is a brush near the target to leap from, and whether your Ferocity is full.
breaks: If the lane has no brush on your approach, the gank is a slow walk; keep clearing.

asks: how do I clear on Sejuani
Sejuani first clear
Sejuani full clear or gank
when does Sejuani gank
say: Full clear and gank with Arctic Assault into Permafrost, or leave after three camps if a target has no dash to dodge the charge.
more: Arctic Assault knocks up and Winter's Wrath builds the Frost that Permafrost needs to stun, so one gank carries two layers of lockdown.
Frost Armor returns when she is out of combat, so a short pause between camps keeps the clear healthy.
check: Which laner has the damage to finish a target you hold.
breaks: If Arctic Assault misses, you have no fast way to reach him; go back to your camps.

asks: how do I clear on Rammus
Rammus first clear
Rammus early gank?
when do I gank on Rammus
say: Full clear with Defensive Ball Curl up, then Powerball into a lane, or gank at three if the target has no dash.
more: Defensive Ball Curl raises his resistances and returns damage to attackers, so monsters hurt themselves on him.
Powerball covers a lane quickly and slows on impact, and Frenzying Taunt then holds the target. Few early ganks bring that much lockdown.
check: Whether minions stand between you and the target on your approach.
breaks: If Powerball hits a minion before the target, the gank is over; turn back for camps.

asks: how do I clear on Volibear
Volibear first clear
Volibear gank or farm
what do I do early on Voli
say: Full clear healthy and take the crab fight, or gank at three with Thundering Smash where the lane is long.
more: Frenzied Maul heals on its second cast against the same target, and Sky Splitter shields him if he stands in it, so camps barely dent him.
Thundering Smash speeds him toward enemies and stuns the first one he attacks, so a gank only needs him to reach the target.
Stormbringer disables towers near his landing at six. Until then, do not follow anyone under a tower.
check: Whether the target can dash away before you reach him.
breaks: If he reaches his tower before the stun lands, stop; come back at six.

asks: how do I clear on Wukong
Wukong first clear
Wukong level three gank?
when does Wukong gank
say: Full clear using Nimbus Strike on grouped camps, then fight at crab, or gank at three by walking in under Warrior Trickster.
more: Nimbus Strike hits enemies near his target, and Stone Skin stacks armor and regeneration while he fights monsters, so the clear is steady.
Warrior Trickster makes him invisible for the approach. He has no hard crowd control until Cyclone, so early ganks need the laner's.
check: Whether your laner has a stun or root to add.
breaks: If the lane has no crowd control, wait for level six and Cyclone before committing.

asks: how do I clear on Gragas
Gragas first clear
Gragas early gank?
when do I gank on Gragas
say: Full clear with Drunken Rage up on every camp, or gank at three with Body Slam if nothing stands between you and the target.
more: Drunken Rage reduces damage taken and his passive heals when he uses a skill, so he clears healthier than he looks.
Body Slam stops on the first enemy it meets and stuns around it, so a minion in the way ruins the gank.
check: Whether minions block the path to the target.
breaks: If Body Slam misses or hits a minion, do not chase on foot; return to your camps.

asks: how do I clear on Rek'Sai
Rek'Sai first clear
Reksai level three gank?
what do I do early on Rek'Sai
say: Full clear, burrowing between camps to heal, then fight at crab, or gank at three by tunnelling in from out of sight.
more: Rek'Sai builds Fury by attacking and spends it while Burrowed to restore health, so burrow on the walk between camps.
Queen's Wrath makes her next attacks hit nearby enemies, which handles grouped camps. Her tunnels last a long time, so later ganks can reuse them.
check: Whether your Fury is high enough to heal before the next camp.
breaks: If the target sees you coming and backs off, keep the tunnel for later and return to camps.

asks: how do I clear on Trundle
Trundle first clear
Trundle farm or fight
when do I gank on Trundle
say: Full clear on Frozen Domain and take the crab duel, or gank at three if Pillar of Ice can block the target's way home.
more: King's Tribute heals him when units die nearby and Frozen Domain gives attack speed and more healing, so he ends the clear healthy.
Chomp takes attack damage from the target, which helps him in early duels against junglers who rely on attacks.
Pillar of Ice is impassable and slows, so placed behind a target it turns a walk-up gank into a real one.
check: Whether their jungler relies on attacks or on abilities.
breaks: If the pillar lands badly, the target simply walks around it; do not chase far.

asks: how do I clear on Skarner
Skarner first clear
Skarner full clear or gank
when does Skarner gank
say: Full clear with Shattered Earth and Seismic Bastion, or gank at three through a wall with Ixtal's Impact when the target stands near terrain.
more: Seismic Bastion shields him and damages around him, so camps are safe even if they are not fast.
Ixtal's Impact passes through terrain and slams a champion into the next wall for a stun, so it needs a wall behind the target.
check: Whether there is a wall close behind the target.
breaks: If the target is standing in the open middle of the lane, there is no wall to stun him on; wait or keep clearing.

asks: how do I clear on Maokai
Maokai first clear
Maokai jungle gank at three?
when does Maokai gank
say: Full clear with saplings thrown into the camps, or gank at three since Twisted Advance roots without needing to aim.
more: Sap Magic heals him on an empowered attack that comes back faster as he casts, so keep using abilities during camps.
Twisted Advance makes him untargetable, dashes to the target and roots on arrival. It does not miss, but it needs him in range first.
check: Whether you can walk into range before the target backs off.
breaks: If the target has Flash and room to run, the root may get only that; take it and return to camps.

asks: how do I clear on Pantheon
Pantheon first clear
Pantheon level three gank?
what do I do early on Pantheon
say: Three camps and gank at level three with Shield Vault's stun, or full clear and look for their jungler at the crab.
more: Shield Vault dashes to a target and stuns, so the gank has lockdown that cannot be dodged. Aegis Assault then blocks damage from the front.
Pantheon is strongest before items even out, so quiet early minutes cost him more than most.
check: Whether the gank lane's wave is on your side.
breaks: If the target is at his tower, do not dive at level three; take the crab or keep clearing.

asks: how do I clear on Poppy
Poppy first clear
Poppy early gank?
when do I gank on Poppy
say: Full clear and gank where Heroic Charge can pin the target to a wall, or leave after three camps if he stands beside one.
more: Heroic Charge only stuns if the target is pushed into terrain, so the angle you arrive from matters more than speed.
Steadfast Presence stops enemy dashes around her, which makes her a strong counter-gank against champions that jump in.
Picking up her buckler gives a shield, so collect it during camps.
check: Whether the target is standing near a wall and which side you can approach from.
breaks: If the target is in the open, the charge just pushes him toward safety; wait for a better position.

asks: how do I clear on Taliyah
Taliyah first clear
Taliyah jungle farm or gank
when does Taliyah gank
say: Full clear with Threaded Volley while kiting, or gank at three by throwing the target with Seismic Shove into Unraveled Earth.
more: She moves freely while casting Threaded Volley, so monsters rarely get to hit her.
Unraveled Earth slows, and enemies knocked through it are stunned, so Seismic Shove into the field is her full lockdown.
Weaver's Wall at six lets her travel a long way to a lane, which is worth farming toward.
check: Whether the target has a dash to leave the Seismic Shove area before it erupts.
breaks: If Seismic Shove misses, the field alone will not hold him; go back to camps.

asks: how do I clear on Olaf
Olaf first clear
Olaf invade or gank
what do I do early on Olaf
say: Full clear and pick up every axe, then fight their jungler at the crab, or gank at three if Undertow lands.
more: Picking up the axe resets Undertow's cooldown, so throw it where you are walking anyway.
Olaf gains attack speed and life steal as his health drops, so a clear that looks rough still leaves him ready to duel.
Undertow's slow is his only way to hold a target early, so ganks depend on that throw.
check: Whether their jungler will actually take the duel or avoid you.
breaks: If he avoids you, do not wander looking for him; take the crab and get back to camps.
